cohort: 1,267 patients presenting with obstetric fistulas, of whom 355 had OVUF
finding: The proportion of obstetric vesico-uterine fistula (OVUF) among women with obstetric fistulas in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is relatively high (28%), with cesarean delivery being the sole identified cause.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the sole identified cause of OVUF, which was isolated, single, and without fibrosis in the majority of cases.
